illustrations.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single wide landscape painterly editorial illustration for an affectionate, deadpan Hindi essay about the eccentric people at an Indian half marathon. Scene on a tree-lined city road in early morning light. Two clear humorous race characters run side by side in the foreground: one lean older runner running effortlessly barefoot, and another cheerful runner dribbling an orange basketball as he runs. A few ordinary well-equipped runners in colourful running shoes behind them look mildly bewildered and a little out of breath. Small generic race bibs without legible words or numbers. Background runners are loose simplified silhouettes. Everyone is a deliberately stylised cartoon character, no realistic portrait or recognisable likeness of the blog author; avoid a bearded man in a cap as central character. Warm handmade gouache and watercolour brush textures on softly grained paper, warm amber sunrise and muted teal/green shadows, visually consistent with literary illustrations of a disappointed ghost outside a mosquito net and personified Time in a spreadsheet. Humour comes from postures and the situation, not exaggerated cruel caricature. Single coherent scene, no multiple panels or collage. Landscape approximately 3:2. No text, captions, logos, watermark, no finish-line banners.

Use case: illustration-story. A single wide landscape painterly editorial illustration for a humorous Hindi personal essay about half-marathon runners. Scene: a water station on the left edge of a tree-lined Indian race route, folding table with volunteers and water bottles. One runner who was on the far side of the road makes a sudden diagonal turn towards the table, surprising two following runners who politely sidestep him with comically exasperated body language. A couple of discarded empty plastic water bottles in the foreground make the road feel like an impromptu football pitch; one runner carefully nudges a bottle out of the way. No one falls or is injured. Clear flowing composition makes the abrupt diagonal move immediately readable. Generic runners with different builds and simple non-realistic faces, no central author likeness, no bearded man in a cap. Warm textured gouache/storybook aesthetic, soft paper grain, muted terracotta, teal and olive with bright morning amber light, matching the other literary-blog race illustration. Understated observational humour, kind rather than grotesque. Single coherent scene, no collage or panels. Wide landscape approximately 3:2, no readable text, no slogans, brand logos, watermark, or captions.
